metric_definitions.agent_sd_ratio_mean: Param. posterior sd / prior sd (agents' own models) (lower is better)
metric_definitions.pooled_sd_ratio_mean: Param. posterior sd / prior sd (all team data pooled) (lower is better)
metric_definitions.agent_info_gain_nats: Information gained, agents' own models (nats) (higher is better)
metric_definitions.pooled_info_gain_nats: Information gained, all team data (nats) (higher is better)
metric_definitions.pooled_info_per_experiment: Information per experiment, team data (nats/exp) (higher is better)
metric_definitions.agent_rmse_ph: Held-out pH RMSE (agents' models) (lower is better)
metric_definitions.agent_rmse_expansion: Held-out expansion RMSE (agents' models) (lower is better)
metric_definitions.agent_regret: Decision regret of agents' recommendation (true cost) (lower is better)
metric_definitions.pooled_regret: Decision regret, pooled-model recommendation (lower is better)
metric_definitions.agent_objective_reached: Fraction of agents whose recommendation is near-optimal (higher is better)
